findings.title: Raw credentials still enter debug logs before sanitization
evidence: src/lib/messaging/native.ts:175 logs msg.payload before the registered NET_CAPTURE_EVENT handler.
src/lib/background/bootstrap.ts:551 receives raw events; networkRelayIsolated sends raw event URLs.
src/lib/debug/log.ts emit stores args.detail without redaction and relays it to debug consumers.
src/lib/tools/dispatch.ts:706 logs rawArgs for data_patterns save before savePattern sanitizes them.
findings.trigger: Capture https://calendar.invalid/api?access_token=SYNTHETIC_SECRET, or invoke data_patterns save with that config. The raw URL enters diagnostic payloads even when the eventual persisted recipe is sanitized.
findings.repair: Suppress payload logging for the Network event boundary (keep safe metadata) and sanitize or omit credential-bearing Network save args before logging/recording. Preserve transient raw identity only in the capture owner; do not indiscriminately scrub ordinary result data.
findings.required_proof: Drive actual native receive and data_patterns save dispatch with canaries; inspect debug-store/log details plus inserted recipe. Mock only external browser/database effects.

findings.title: Actual save sink still persists credential-bearing userinfo in names
evidence: product.patch sanitizeNetworkPatternName inspects only query segments and key=value name text. It never removes username/password from a name URL.
savePattern passes this safeName directly to wbx_pattern.insert.
findings.trigger: Direct save name="Network: https://user:SYNTHETIC_PASSWORD@calendar.invalid/api" with matching rawFilter and network_capture kind. The URL config loses userinfo, but the name retains it.
findings.repair: Apply known URL-userinfo protection to URL-derived names at the sink, including partial/truncated legacy defaults where possible. Ensure the network sink applies when config is absent, not only when networkConfig is truthy.
findings.required_proof: Extend actual savePattern insert test with full userinfo name and absent-config recognized credential name; serialized payload must omit canaries.

findings.title: Opaque body identity is only type-checked as string at persistence
evidence: product.patch savePattern whitelist persists any string networkConfig.request_body_key.
data_patterns config is z.record(z.unknown()); direct save callers can supply arbitrary text.
NetworkTab forwards selected.request_body_key; relay accepts page-posted event payload without validating this format.
findings.trigger: Network save config request_body_key="Bearer SYNTHETIC_SECRET" is copied unchanged into persisted config despite the stated never-save-body-or-credential contract.
findings.repair: Accept only the actual producer formats (none, unavailable, sha256 plus 64 hex digits); malformed values become explicitly unavailable or a truthful validation error rather than persisted raw text. Preserve ordinary row data.
findings.required_proof: Actual save sink and Network UI save with malformed body-key canary must never insert the canary and must report unavailable identity honestly.

findings.title: Explicit unknown-key choice does not mask the capture-list row
evidence: product.patch NetworkTab event list renders shortenUrl(sanitizeNetworkUrl(e.url)) without extraCredentialKeys.
Preview and input pass extraCredentialKeys, so one selected event has two inconsistent privacy views.
findings.trigger: Select request ?proof=SYNTHETIC_SECRET, mark proof as credential. Preview/input mask it, but the selected list row still renders the raw value.
findings.repair: Apply the selected event's explicit override consistently to its list representation; do not silently apply a per-event choice to unrelated captured requests.
findings.required_proof: Real NetworkTab checkbox test asserts no canary in all rendered text/input/attributes after marking the key. Existing pending test may expose this; no execution claimed.

findings.title: Unknown keys added to the editable replay matcher cannot be marked
evidence: product.patch queryKeys derives only from selected.url.
The replay matcher is editable and savedUrlFilter uses replayUrlFilter.
findings.trigger: Select a request without proof, edit matcher to include proof=SYNTHETIC_SECRET. No Treat proof as credential control exists, and saving persists this unrecognized credential even though UI says review every query key.
findings.repair: Derive reviewable keys from the effective edited matcher as well as the selected request, preserving per-key overrides and literal ordinary query identity.
findings.required_proof: Edit the real matcher to add an unknown key, mark it, save through the real sink, and assert no canary plus unchanged ordinary date/page values.

positive_findings: Exact matching retains query segment bytes and order while masking recognized or explicitly chosen credential values. Date/page distinctions survive source inspection.
Saved masked URL can match a rotated credential across runs; in-window transient credential fingerprints participate in the ambiguity identity so distinct credentials are not silently merged.
Save sink drops unrecognized config side fields such as raw_event_url, preventing that obvious persistence bypass.
Unknown-key uncertainty is stated in UI instead of claiming universal credential detection.
limitations: All findings are source-derived, not reproduced runtime results. Sol owns the sole runtime permit.
Hash/fingerprint implementation is not cryptographic anonymity; it is transient equality discrimination, and must not be persisted or logged.
Historical database cleanup is outside this patch and not reviewed as completed.
Prepared tests cover useful UI-to-save and runner paths, but do not cover the generic logging boundary, userinfo name, malformed body identity or edited-key control gap.
coordination: Important findings sent to parent before application. D47 remains paused with no overlap edits. No live product change, test/build/browser launch, DB mutation or push performed.
